# Liminal Forests Alliance

> The Liminal Forests Alliance works to secure large, ecologically important wild landscapes around the world - old-growth rainforest, wetlands, wilderness and wildlife corridors - and to place each one in an independent trust, so it stays protected for generations.

## Policy on AI use

This site welcomes search and answer crawlers and permits AI systems to read and cite its public pages. It does NOT permit use of its content for AI model training. The machine-readable signal on every robots.txt group is: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no. Known AI-training crawlers are disallowed in robots.txt and additionally receive an HTTP 403.

## How the model works

- Find the land: track large, ecologically significant properties on the open market - rainforest, wetlands, wilderness and connecting corridors.
- Secure it: acquire each property with the single goal of protection, not development, logging or resale.
- Place it in trust: transfer the land into an independent trust that holds it for conservation.
- Keep it that way: protection is written into how the land is held, so it lasts for generations.

Property details are provided by independent third-party brokers and are subject to change; confirm all details directly with each broker.

## Pages

- [Home](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/): overview of the alliance, why wild land matters, and how the trust model works. Land currently for sale lives on the Old Growth page below.
- [Home (Markdown)](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/index.md): the same content as plain Markdown for machine reading.
- [Old Growth](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/old-growth): photo cards of large, ecologically important wild land currently listed for sale by independent brokers, each linking to the broker's listing.
- [Old Growth (Markdown)](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/old-growth.md): the inventory as plain Markdown for machine reading.
- [Rewilding](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/rewilding): working plantations, logged leases and farm lots listed for sale by independent brokers, tracked for their restoration potential rather than as wild land; separate from the Old Growth page above.
- [Rewilding (Markdown)](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/rewilding.md): the rewilding candidates as plain Markdown for machine reading.
- [Dispatches (blog)](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog): short, sourced stories about large wild land that has changed hands, and what became of it.
- [Dispatches (Markdown)](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog.md): the blog index as plain Markdown.
- [Dispatches (RSS)](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/rss.xml): RSS 2.0 feed of the dispatches.

## Blog

Each dispatch is a short, sourced story. Facts are drawn from the cited sources and were accurate as of November 2026. An HTML page and a Markdown alternate are listed for each.

- From sheep ranch to national park: the Chacabuco Valley (Chile, conservation win) - [HTML](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/patagonia-national-park-chacabuco) and [Markdown](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/patagonia-national-park-chacabuco.md)
- A rainforest saved at auction: Chile's Valdivian coast (Chile, conservation win) - [HTML](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/valdivian-coastal-reserve) and [Markdown](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/valdivian-coastal-reserve.md)
- 253,000 acres of Appalachia, bought to keep working (USA, conservation win) - [HTML](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/cumberland-forest-appalachia) and [Markdown](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/cumberland-forest-appalachia.md)
- The world's largest rhino farm, handed to conservation (South Africa, conservation win) - [HTML](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/platinum-rhino-african-parks) and [Markdown](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/platinum-rhino-african-parks.md)
- Bon Bon: a sheep station the size of a small country, retired (Australia, conservation win) - [HTML](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/bon-bon-station-reserve) and [Markdown](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/bon-bon-station-reserve.md)
- The Lost Forest that lived up to its name (Scotland, cautionary tale) - [HTML](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/brewdog-lost-forest-kinrara) and [Markdown](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/brewdog-lost-forest-kinrara.md)
- An island of forest, and the soy frontier closing in (Bolivia, cautionary tale) - [HTML](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/chiquitano-dry-forest-inpa) and [Markdown](https://liminalforestsalliance.com/blog/chiquitano-dry-forest-inpa.md)
